title: Plan the Trade Before You’re In It
hook: Manage the plan. Not the emotion.

launchpad.outcome: Write and lock a management plan before the position exists, and notice when you try to change it.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What is my plan once I’m in?

slides.line: YOU’RE IN. 🎉 …and then the money starts moving.
slides.sub: TAKE PROFIT? MOVE STOP? CLOSE? MOVE TARGET? NOW WHAT? 😭

slides.title: Fill it in. Then lock it.

choices.prompt: MANAGEMENT PLAN: how will you manage it?

options.label: Fixed: hold to the 60-point target or the 30-point stop
I’ll see how it feels
options.feedback: You have an entry plan. You don’t have a trade plan.

choices.prompt: WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU INTERVENE EARLY?

options.label: A 1M close below the 1H HL (thesis invalidated)
options.why: A structural reason, written down now.

options.label: If I’m up and get nervous
options.feedback: That’s an emotion, not a condition.

options.label: If I lose $100
options.feedback: That’s P&L, not structure. Your stop already defines the loss.

ask.prompt: Another trader enters with an EMPTY management plan: “I’ll see how it feels.” What does she have?

options.label: A trade plan
options.feedback: She has an entry. Nothing for after it.

options.label: An entry plan, not a trade plan
options.why: YOU HAVE AN ENTRY PLAN. YOU DON’T HAVE A TRADE PLAN.

slides.title: Now try to change it

checkpoints.prompt: It gave some back. Now red. Anything to do?

slides.intro: Your plan is locked. Try touching it and see what happens.

slides.quote: Your calmest decisions should happen before money starts moving.

slides.prompt: Why should management exist before entry?
slides.modelAnswer: Because once I’m in, P&L starts talking. If the plan is written and locked before that, I only have to follow it, and any change has to answer: what changed?

remember: Your calmest decisions should happen before money starts moving.
